title: How to feel youthful at heart - the wisdom of children
en: hello everyone and welcome to the cottage fairy in this video i wanted to share how i resolved many of my inner struggles by getting back in touch with my childhood spirit for those of you who don't know i work with children for a living and i'm constantly surprised by their frankness curiosity joy and insight into the human condition just the other day i was told by a little boy that more than anything in the world he wanted to be a star in the night sky so that people may wish on him i found this to be a clever idea and decided to make a painting inspired by the night sky through the eyes of a dreaming child i was able to transform my experience of

daily living by reigniting my imagination and childlike joy have you tried jumping in rain puddles recently finding little innocent joys like that helped me recall the wonder and magic and beauty of daily living creating meaningful human connection can sometimes feel complex and sadly to some unattainable but as young children there was a time when we were unencumbered by feelings of

inadequacy and self-judgment we simply reached out with openness and directness unafraid of what was to come i think there is much wisdom to be learned from the hearts of children and many broken spirits healed simply by recalling a time before painful experiences stole their ability to love without fear as a child i was enchanted by the forest

beside my home and i'd often take little pieces of it back with me in the form of pinecones feathers and abandoned birds nests i'd like to imagine they were little gifts left for me by the fairies even today i find that one's environment is key to their ability to thrive this may not be true for everyone but for me it was vital to create a space in which i felt i could be my best self

in order to get back in touch with myself i pursued the interest that i'd always had as a child and now still these are things that are intrinsic to who you are to me that was my love of nature of art of reading by keeping alive passions that you have had for your entire life i find you consequently connect with your inner soul

the greatest challenge in my life is one that i think that many of us face especially if you have a more sensitive spirit it is to be unashamed there was a time when you had no concept of shame when you were very young you had never felt it before your past does not define you and your future is unwritten

new beginnings never come too late and all you can do is go forward and to be proud of who you are i hope you found this video comforting i would love to hear about your favorite childhood memories below hope you have a lovely day or night and i will see you next week
zh: 大家好，欢迎来到这个视频中的小屋仙女，我想分享我如何通过重新接触我的童年精神来解决我内心的许多挣扎，对于那些不知道我以儿童为生的人来说，我经常对他们的坦率、好奇、快乐和对人类状况的洞察感到惊讶，就在前几天，一个小男孩告诉我，他最想成为夜空中的一颗星星，这样人们就会希望他，我发现这是一个聪明的主意，决定画一幅画。通过一个做梦的孩子的眼睛受到夜空的启发，我能够改变我的经历
日常生活，重新点燃我的想象力和孩童般的快乐，你尝试过在雨坑里跳吗？最近发现了这样的小天真快乐，帮助我回想起日常生活的奇迹、魔力和美丽，创造有意义的人际关系有时会让一些人感到复杂和悲伤，这是遥不可及的，但作为年幼的孩子，有一段时间我们没有被感情所束缚。
不足和自我判断，我们只是以开放和直接的方式伸出援手，不惧怕即将发生的事情，我认为从孩子们的心中可以学到很多智慧，许多破碎的精神只需回忆起痛苦的经历夺走他们无所畏惧地去爱的能力之前的一段时光，我就被森林迷住了
在我家旁边，我经常以松果羽毛和废弃鸟巢的形式带回一些小碎片，我想把它们想象成仙女们留给我的小礼物，即使在今天我发现一个人的环境是他们茁壮成长的关键，这可能不适用于每个人，但对我来说，创造一个让我觉得自己可以成为最好的自己的空间至关重要
为了重新与自己保持联系，我追求了我小时候一直拥有的兴趣，现在这些仍然是我内心深处的东西，这是我对阅读艺术本质的热爱，通过保持你一生的热情，我发现你因此与你的内在灵魂联系在一起
我生命中最大的挑战是我认为我们许多人都面临的挑战，特别是如果你有更敏感的精神，那就是不感到羞耻，曾经有一段时间，你没有羞耻的概念，当你很小的时候，你从来没有感觉到羞耻，直到你的过去无法定义你，你的未来是不成文的。
新的开始永远不会太晚，你所能做的就是继续前进，为自己感到自豪我希望你觉得这个视频令人安慰我很想听听下面你最喜欢的童年回忆希望你有一个美好的白天或夜晚，我下周见你
